page.notes: Printed "Ecclesia" with long s, rendered as plain s. "frustrà" rendered with plain s. Hyphens at line ends kept as printed. The quotation "DABO PRINCIPES TVOS IN PACE, ET EPISCOPOS TVOS IN IVSTITIA" is printed in spaced capitals, with the line-end break "PRINCI-PES" kept. The word "Quid" at the end is part of the last full line, so it is not a catchword. Small marks and smudges in the margins (at the top left, right of line 3, and near "Quid est") are not printed text and are omitted.
